title: Connect kernel components to device support
goal: Distinguish loaded modules from built-in drivers without changing either.
challenge: Identify one available driver, its parameters and whether it is built in or loadable. Correlate that with loaded-module evidence. Do not load, unload or change parameters.

steps.command: w=/home/learner/ll-discovery-2; test "$(id -un)" = learner && test ! -e "$w" && test ! -L "$w" && mkdir -m 0700 -- "$w" && cd -- "$w" && test "$(df -Pk . | awk 'NR==2 {print $4}')" -ge 65536
steps.explanation: Create a fresh private workspace; stop on collision or insufficient space.
steps.expected: Exact learner path, no existing entry, at least64MiB free.

steps.command: guard() { local links; test "$(pwd -P)" = /home/learner/ll-discovery-2 && test ! -L /home/learner/ll-discovery-2 && test "$(stat -c %U .)" = learner && links=$(sudo find . -type l -print -quit) && test -z "$links"; }; guard
steps.expected: No path substitution; guest root can override guest safeguards.

steps.command: unrelated() { dpkg-query -W -f='${binary:Package}\t${Version}\t${db:Status-Status}\n' | awk '$1!="ll-discovery-data" && $1!="ll-discovery-report"'; }; unrelated > before.tsv; sudo sha256sum /etc/sudoers.d/learning-lab > sudo.before; id learner > learner.before; scope_ok() { guard && unrelated > after.tsv && cmp before.tsv after.tsv && sudo sha256sum -c sudo.before && id learner > learner.after && cmp learner.before learner.after; }; scope_ok
steps.explanation: Retain unrelated package and learner/sudo evidence before any transaction.
steps.expected: Protected unrelated state captured; stop on mismatch.

steps.command: guard && { uname -r; head -n 6 /proc/modules; lsmod | head -n 6; } > modules.txt && cat modules.txt
steps.explanation: Loaded modules are one part of the running kernel.
steps.expected: Current kernel and a bounded module list; absence alone does not prove a missing driver.

steps.command: guard && { /sbin/modinfo -F filename virtio_pci; /sbin/modinfo -F parm virtio_pci; } > driver.txt && cat driver.txt
steps.explanation: Use the verified absolute path; virtio_pci is built into this pinned kernel.
steps.expected: (builtin) and a declared parameter; it is not a package-owned module-file path.

steps.explanation: Kernel-version-specific module metadata describes available components.
steps.expected: Paths including built-in/dependency metadata; no module mutation.

hints: lsmod does not list every built-in driver.
modinfo works at /sbin/modinfo even when that directory is absent from PATH.
Do not pass (builtin) to a file ownership query.
review: Driver classification, parameter and loaded-module observations; no loading/unloading.
coverage: LPIC-2 v4.5 201.3 partial kernel/module querying. Self-reviewed, unscored; not complete objectives.
